description: Composite figure tracking retained austenite (RA) through thermomechanical processing of a low-density steel; it mixes EBSD-style phase maps, size histograms, a statistical curve and an XRD pattern. (a) HR is a phase map (10 µm scale bar) whose Phase/Fraction table gives FCC 0 and BCC 1.000, the whole field being red (no RA). (b) AN750 phase map: FCC 0.030, BCC 0.970, with sparse small green FCC (RA) grains in a red BCC matrix. (c) AN800 and (d) AN850 phase maps (30 µm scale bars) give FCC 0.011/BCC 0.989 and FCC 0.002/BCC 0.998. The annealed maps carry inset RA size histograms (Fraction vs Diameter µm) with printed D_AVE = 0.59, 0.72 and 0.83 µm respectively. (e) is a line plot of RA content (vol%) vs Sample, with printed points HR ≈0, AN750 = 3.0, AN800 = 1.1, AN850 = 0.2. (f) stacks XRD patterns (Intensity a.u. vs 2θ = 30-100°) for HR, AN750, AN800 and AN850, labelled α(110), γ(200), α(200), γ(220), α(211), γ(311), α(220). Collectively the panels show RA peaks at AN750 then falls with rising annealing temperature while the remaining RA coarsens, and the γ reflections in (f) confirm the FCC fractions.

subfigures.description: EBSD-style phase map labelled HR with a Phase/Fraction table listing FCC 0 and BCC 1.000; the field is entirely red (BCC) with black boundaries; 10 µm scale bar. No RA present.
Phase map labelled AN750 with Phase/Fraction table FCC 0.030, BCC 0.970; red BCC matrix containing sparse small green FCC (RA) grains.

Phase map (30 µm scale bar) corresponding to the AN800 condition; Phase/Fraction table FCC 0.011, BCC 0.989, with an inset RA size histogram (Fraction vs Diameter µm) headed D_AVE = 0.72, peaking near 1.2 µm.
Phase map (30 µm scale bar) corresponding to AN850; Phase/Fraction table FCC 0.002, BCC 0.998, with an inset RA size histogram headed D_AVE = 0.83 µm showing two bars at about 0.4 and 1.2 µm.
Line plot of RA content (vol%) against Sample (HR, AN750, AN800, AN850) using green half-filled markers; printed values HR ≈0, AN750 = 3.0, AN800 = 1.1, AN850 = 0.2.
Stacked XRD patterns (Intensity a.u. vs 2θ = 30-100°) for HR, AN750, AN800 and AN850, with reflections labelled α(110), γ(200), α(200), γ(220), α(211), γ(311) and α(220).

Three RA size distributions rendered as separate bar charts: D_AVE = 0.59 (x ticks 0.55, 0.60), D_AVE = 0.72 (x ticks 0.8, 1.2) and D_AVE = 0.83 (x ticks 0.4, 0.8, 1.2); y-axis is Fraction (0 to 0.4).

observations.observation: Panel (a) HR phase map has a Phase/Fraction table reading FCC 0 and BCC 1.000, i.e. the hot-rolled condition is wholly BCC (no RA).
Panel (b) AN750 phase map table reads FCC 0.030 and BCC 0.970.
The AN800 and AN850 phase maps give FCC fractions of 0.011 and 0.002 (BCC 0.989 and 0.998), showing the FCC/RA fraction shrinking with higher annealing temperature.
Inset RA size histograms print average RA diameters D_AVE = 0.59, 0.72 and 0.83 µm.
Panel (e) prints RA content values of 3.0 vol% (AN750), 1.1 vol% (AN800) and 0.2 vol% (AN850), with HR near 0.
Panel (f) XRD patterns are labelled with α(110), γ(200), α(200), γ(220), α(211), γ(311) and α(220) reflections over 2θ = 30-100°.
Scale bars are 10 µm in (a) and 30 µm in the (c)/(d) phase maps.
The caption identifies the panels as (a) HR, (b) AN750, (c) AN800, (d) AN850, (e) evolution statistics of RA content and (f) XRD analysis.
The citing text states the hot-rolled microstructure consists of bainite with fresh martensite and that the Fig. 3(a) phase distribution is entirely BCC.
The citing text states that as the annealing temperature increases the RA content gradually decreases, matching the statistics of Fig. 3(e).
The citing text states the inset figures show the average grain size (D_AVE) distribution of RA for each sample, and that XRD (Fig. 3(f)) further confirms the RA trend.
RA content rises from HR to a maximum at AN750 then falls monotonically to AN850, whereas the RA average diameter increases from 0.59 to 0.83 µm.

unreadable_items: The inset RA histograms are not individually labelled with their sample name in the pixels; the mapping D_AVE 0.59/0.72/0.83 µm to AN750/AN800/AN850 is inferred and not printed on the panels
One phase map shows a 30 µm scale bar without a visible inset histogram, so its exact panel assignment ((c) vs (d)) is ambiguous
Panel (e) y-axis smallest tick values below 0.2 are not individually readable
